title: 佐伊·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 橙粉渐变至紫色的长发围着雀斑面容，异色双眼保留年幼比例。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Zoe is a childlike celestial girl with extremely long orange-pink hair fading to violet, differently colored eyes, freckles, and youthful human proportions. Preserve her child age and bright cosmic ornaments, using a fully covering long-sleeved tunic, opaque leggings, boots, and a short star-trimmed cape without adultization or sexualized styling.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: orange pink, violet, gold, cosmic blue, indigo; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
